source_replicate_notes: Original scores use saved 4.6.0 rescore sidecars; repeats use native 4.6.0 verifier scores.
Analysis reads scores only; no predictions, ground truth, or existing figures are modified.
All 20 protocol task prompts match across the three attempts; CLI/model/reasoning settings match.
Originals ran 2026-08-16; repeats ran 2026-10-10. Runtime-injected context, including date and plugin lists, differs. Observed variation is not isolated sampling randomness.
The two repeats are ordered by start time within each protocol, not shared random seeds or synchronized rounds.
Means are equal-weight protocol averages of replicate means, never best-of-three or pass@3.
The one-per-protocol 95% range samples uniformly from observed outputs independently per protocol. It is descriptive sensitivity, not a confidence or prediction interval for future executions.
Bootstrap CIs use percentile resampling of 20 protocol clusters, preserving all three attempts together. They describe across-protocol uncertainty conditional on the observed attempts.
Run-noise SE estimates use sample within-protocol variances and independence/stationarity assumptions; n=3 reduces this component by sqrt(3), not all uncertainty.

Identical scorer version is verified; saved score files do not record full ground-truth content hashes, so byte-identical scoring ground truth cannot be independently certified from these files alone.
No equivalence threshold was prespecified. These data cannot establish n=1 equivalence or determine replicate needs for other models.
